subject.name: Voltera
subject.primaryJob: make printing circuits approachable without losing technical credibility
sources: the three printed pads of the V mark (V11)
blue for research and green for PCBs (V13)

principles: hierarchy that is apparent and easy to scan (V12)
a stated color ratio across the whole design (V13)

territories.name: The electronics bench
territories.description: A clean bench with a printer, boards and bright conductive traces on a monochrome ground.

muse.name: a circuit pad
muse.take: three printed pads that form a mark (V11)

signature.reason: V14's tiles share the printed pad's generous corner (V11), which answers the muse on the bench territory

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred, not stated by the source. Departs from Swiss crisp corners: pads and tiles are round.
rationale.type.faces: Stand-in for display: Lato (V12) is outside the catalogue; Source Sans 3 is the closest humanist. Inter is named on V12.
rationale.type.weights: Lato Bold for titles, Semibold for subheaders (V12)
rationale.adaptivity: the accents read as text only on dark grounds (V13)
rationale.color.anchors.0: V13, printed HEX; 30% of a design.
rationale.color.anchors.1: V13, printed HEX; 10% of a design.
rationale.color.character.solid-depth: One step deeper solids so text on the primary clears contrast in both schemes; the exact brand color stays pinned.
